operators.name: file_docket
operators.precondition: Some title in the pool is not yet filed.
operators.effect: Creates a Docket with the next code D-101, D-102, ..., the first free title, stamp 'wet', notes 0, registered false.

operators.name: enter_register
operators.effect: Sets registered true.  The docket now also appears in the register table; it is the same docket, not a copy.

operators.name: turn_stamp
operators.effect: Flips stamp between 'wet' and 'dry'.  A registered docket's row in the register table shows the new stamp too: one entity, two rows.
